title: Geometric mean quantization via adaptive approximation
summary: Let $ν$ be a compactly supported Borel probability measure on $\mathbb R^{d}$ with $ν(B(x,r))\leq Cr^{a}$ for some $a>0$. Refine a dyadic cube exactly when its mass is at least $t$, and let $\mathcal{L}_ν(t)$ be the mean depth at which this refinement stops. We show that the lower and upper geometric-mean quantization dimensions of $ν$ are the lower and upper limits of $\log(1/t)/\mathcal{L}_ν(t)$.
